40142804.clinical_problem: predicting long-term psychomotor and mental developmental outcomes in very-low-birth-weight preterm infants from term-equivalent-age brain MRI volumetry
40142804.patient_population: 150 very low birth weight (<1500 g) preterm infants assessed at term-equivalent age MRI and 18-24 months corrected age
40142804.model_description: Input: automated brain volumetry (Infant FreeSurfer) and diffusion tensor imaging metrics from term-equivalent-age MRI plus clinical data; output: random forest/logistic regression prediction of low Psychomotor and Mental Development Index at 18-24 months.
40142804.headline_result: AUROC 0.9297 (Psychomotor Development Index) and 0.7755 (Mental Development Index) using combined clinical and MRI volumetry model
40142804.study_design: retrospective model development and validation study

40150669.clinical_problem: predicting prognosis (overall survival) of pediatric medulloblastoma using MRI radiomics combined with clinical features
40150669.model_description: Input: radiomics features extracted from T1-weighted MRI tumor regions of interest plus clinical/molecular features; output: risk stratification and survival prediction via a combined clinical-radiomics model.
40150669.headline_result: clinical-radiomics model C-index 0.860 vs. radiomics-only 0.762 vs. clinical-only 0.806

40172160.model_family: random forest (best of eight compared machine learning algorithms)
40172160.clinical_problem: predicting prenatal risk of cephalopelvic disproportion-related dystocia using maternal and fetal (sonographic) parameters
40172160.patient_population: women stratified into planned cesarean, emergency cesarean due to CPD-related dystocia, and vaginal delivery groups
40172160.model_description: Input: 21 selected maternal and fetal parameters, including sonographic estimated fetal weight, head circumference, abdominal circumference, biparietal diameter, and femur length; output: random forest prediction of cephalopelvic disproportion-related dystocia risk, deployed as a web-based tool.
40172160.headline_result: random forest model AUC 0.824 (training), 0.723 in independent validation

40180003.model_family: deep learning with 2.5D slicing for uncertainty-aware brain age estimation
40180003.clinical_problem: estimating brain age with uncertainty quantification from MRI, applied to detect accelerated brain aging in adolescents with ADHD
40180003.patient_population: 11 public MRI datasets (N=6,327) spanning children through older adults, with a subgroup analysis in adolescents with ADHD
40180003.model_description: Input: 2.5D-sliced structural brain MRI; output: brain age estimate with an accompanying uncertainty score from a spectral-normalized neural Gaussian process, used to detect accelerated brain aging in ADHD.
40180003.headline_result: MAE 2.95 years on the main dataset, MAE 3.47 years on independent validation; uncertainty adjustment increased effect size for accelerated brain aging in ADHD adolescents by 38%

40186654.model_family: ResNet50-based deep learning combined with radiomics (Pyradiomics) in a nomogram
40186654.clinical_problem: noninvasively predicting hepatocyte CK7 status and cholestasis progression in children with pancreaticobiliary maljunction using MRI
40186654.model_description: Input: preoperative MRI processed with pretrained ResNet50 and Pyradiomics feature extraction plus clinical features; output: deep learning radiomics nomogram predicting hepatocyte CK7 expression status and cholestasis progression.
40186654.headline_result: deep learning radiomics nomogram AUC 0.95 in validation cohort (deep learning signature AUC 0.92 vs. radiomics signature AUC 0.81)

40191138.clinical_problem: using deep learning-based brain MRI phenotyping to identify structural brain malformations and their associated rare genetic disorders
40191138.patient_population: pediatric brain MRIs (883 from a public dataset and 396 from the Preschool MRI dataset) drawn from a 413-image, 56-disorder database
40191138.model_description: Input: brain MRI encoded via ResNet-50 transfer learning (pretrained for age prediction) into a Clinical Brain Phenotype Space feature vector; output: phenotypic-similarity-based identification of structural brain malformations (e.g., Dandy-Walker malformation) and associated rare disorders.
40191138.dataset_size: 413 brain MRI images across 56 disorders; pediatric subset of 883+396 MRIs
40191138.headline_result: Dandy-Walker malformation and Ogden syndrome each formed distinct, separable clusters from controls via leave-one-out cross-validation (no explicit accuracy percentage given)
40191138.study_design: methods development and feasibility study (conference abstract)

40208761.model_family: deep learning with a feature decoupling transformer
40208761.clinical_problem: automated landmark detection in the fetal cerebellum on 3D MRI to assess fetal brain development
40208761.model_description: Input: 3D fetal brain MRI; output: cerebellum anatomical landmark coordinates from a shared-encoder network with landmark-regression and anatomical pseudo-label segmentation decoders.
40208761.study_design: methods development study with a new benchmark

40232228.model_family: stack classifier ensembled with modified VGG-19 (plus SVM, CatBoost, random forest)
40232228.clinical_problem: detecting autism spectrum disorder in children from structural and functional brain MRI using machine learning
40232228.patient_population: children in the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I and II) datasets
40232228.model_description: Input: combined structural and functional MRI features from ABIDE I/II; output: stack-classifier ensemble (with a deep CNN) classification of autism spectrum disorder vs. controls.
40232228.headline_result: stack classifier accuracy 81.68% (sensitivity 85.08%, specificity 79.13%) on ABIDE I; 81.34% (83.61%, 82.21%) on ABIDE II
40232228.study_design: retrospective model development and comparison study

40239713.model_family: CNN transfer learning (EfficientNet B0, VGG16, Inception V3)
40239713.clinical_problem: recognizing open fetal neural tube defect (open spina bifida) via the lemon sign on axial cranial ultrasound using deep learning
40239713.patient_population: 59 fetuses with open neural tube defect and 116 normal controls, 14-28 weeks gestation
40239713.model_description: Input: axial trans-thalamic fetal cranial ultrasound images; output: CNN transfer-learning classification of normal vs. open neural tube defect (lemon sign) fetuses.
40239713.headline_result: EfficientNet B0 achieved 100%/95.83% training/validation accuracy, sensitivity 100%, specificity 89%

40252878.model_family: unsupervised machine learning data fusion (transposed Independent Vector Analysis)
40252878.clinical_problem: characterizing joint functional and structural brain network abnormalities distinguishing pediatric bipolar disorder from healthy controls, including type I vs. type II subtypes
40252878.patient_population: 58 pediatric bipolar disorder patients and 21 healthy controls matched for age, gender, education, and IQ
40252878.model_description: Input: resting-state regional homogeneity and gray matter concentration MRI maps; output: joint independent-component networks distinguishing pediatric bipolar disorder from controls and type I from type II subtypes via unsupervised data fusion.

40258953.clinical_problem: estimating time-since-injury for pediatric long-bone fractures from radiographs to support fracture dating in accidental injury evaluation
40258953.patient_population: 399 children under 6 years old with accidental long bone fractures, seen at a large Midwestern children's hospital
40258953.model_description: Input: radiographs of accidental long-bone fractures; output: deep learning classification into fracture-age groups and direct estimation of time-since-injury.
40258953.headline_result: best model MAE 6.2 days, with 68% of estimates within 7 days of the correct fracture age
40258953.study_design: retrospective secondary data analysis with cross-validation

40273823.clinical_problem: classifying prevalent thoracic diseases on pediatric chest X-rays using neuromorphic spiking neural networks
40273823.patient_population: pediatric chest radiographs from the public PediCXR benchmark dataset
40273823.model_description: Input: pediatric chest X-rays (PediCXR dataset); output: spiking-neural-network classification across six thoracic illness categories using spatiotemporal, event-driven processing.
40273823.headline_result: Hierarchical Spiking Neural Network (HSNN) achieved 96% classification accuracy across six thoracic illness categories, F1 0.95, specificity 1.0 for pneumonia detection
40273823.study_design: retrospective model development and benchmarking study

40291904.model_family: logistic regression radiomics signature combined with a clinical nomogram
40291904.clinical_problem: predicting progression-free survival in pediatric posterior mediastinal malignancies using preoperative CT radiomics
40291904.model_description: Input: preoperative contrast-enhanced CT radiomics features plus clinical data (Ki-67 index, metastasis); output: radiomics nomogram predicting progression-free survival.
40291904.headline_result: radiomics nomogram AUC 0.87 (Brier score 0.22) in the test set, outperforming the clinical model (AUC 0.82) and radiomics-only model (AUC 0.77)

40314702.model_family: deep learning bone-boundary delineation with optimization-based image alignment
40314702.clinical_problem: using AI-aligned point-of-care ultrasound instead of X-rays to diagnose pediatric distal forearm fractures and reduce radiation exposure
40314702.patient_population: children with distal forearm injuries imaged with point-of-care ultrasound
40314702.model_description: Input: paired point-of-care ultrasound images of the distal forearm; output: deep-learning-delineated bone boundaries and landmarks used to automatically align ultrasound image pairs for fracture classification and angulation measurement.

40327094.model_family: radiomics score (Cox regression) combined with a clinical biomarker (neuron-specific enolase)
40327094.clinical_problem: improving survival prediction in high-risk pediatric neuroblastoma by combining a clinical marker (neuron-specific enolase) with CT radiomics
40327094.patient_population: 140 patients with high-risk neuroblastoma (70 training, 30 test, 40 external validation) from two centers
40327094.model_description: Input: venous-phase enhanced CT radiomics features plus neuron-specific enolase; output: combined model predicting overall survival in high-risk neuroblastoma, externally validated.
40327094.headline_result: combined model 5-year overall survival AUC 0.780 (train), 0.742 (test), 0.710 (external validation); concordance indices 0.730/0.707/0.690
40327094.study_design: two-center retrospective study with external validation

40328996.model_family: radiomics signature (logistic regression) combined with a clinical nomogram
40328996.clinical_problem: predicting vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) expression in pediatric nephroblastoma (Wilms tumor) using CT radiomics
40328996.model_description: Input: CT radiomics features extracted from a manually marked tumor region of interest plus clinicopathological data; output: radiomics-based nomogram predicting VEGF expression level.

40351693.model_family: various AI/deep learning models for ultrasound image analysis (ResNet, DenseNet among others)
40351693.clinical_problem: assessing the diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted echocardiography for fetal congenital heart disease
40351693.patient_population: fetal echocardiography studies pooled across 7 included studies (19 datasets)
40351693.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI-assisted echocardiographic image-analysis models used to diagnose fetal congenital heart disease, pooling diagnostic accuracy across 7 studies.
40351693.headline_result: pooled sensitivity 0.93, specificity 0.93, AUC (SROC) 0.98; ResNet/DenseNet architectures had better diagnostic performance than other models

40372847.model_family: cross-view fusion convolutional neural network (dual-branch with cross-attention)
40372847.clinical_problem: detecting possible serious bacterial infection in newborns using multi-view cranial ultrasound images
40372847.patient_population: newborn infants undergoing cranial ultrasound at Mbale Regional Referral Hospital, Uganda
40372847.model_description: Input: paired coronal and sagittal cranial ultrasound images; output: intersection-guided cross-view fusion network combining both views to classify possible serious bacterial infection vs. non-infection.
40372847.headline_result: CLIF-Net demonstrated substantially enhanced performance over prevailing state-of-the-art infection detection techniques (no single numeric metric stated)
40372847.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation study

40397588.clinical_problem: automated bone age estimation from elbow joint X-rays in Chinese Han adolescents and children, as an alternative to the hand/wrist method
40397588.patient_population: 943 Chinese Han adolescents and children aged 6.00 to <16.00 years, from East, South, Central and Northwest China
40397588.model_description: Input: elbow joint frontal-view radiographs, optionally segmented; output: bone age estimate from a regression CNN (best: UNet++ segmentation of the full elbow joint feeding a DenseNet121 regressor).
40397588.dataset_size: 943 radiographs (754 train/validation, 189 internal test, 104 external test)
40397588.headline_result: best model (DenseNet121, full-joint segmentation) internal MAE 0.83 years, external MAE 0.89 years; P+/-0.7yr 70.03%, P+/-1.0yr 84.30%
40397588.study_design: retrospective model development with internal and external validation

40406668.model_family: ensemble deep learning model (brain shape analysis combined with FSQC metrics)
40406668.clinical_problem: automating quality control of large-scale pediatric and adolescent brain MRI datasets (ABCD Study)
40406668.patient_population: Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study participants, over 20,000 MRI sessions
40406668.model_description: Input: cortical thickness, curvature, sulcal depth, and surface area features from brain MRI, combined with FSQC metrics; output: ensemble model automated pass/fail quality-control classification.
40406668.headline_result: ensemble QC model accuracy 76%; proposed shape-based method accuracy 72.62%, with balanced precision/recall/F1
